question: Four animals have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Fox.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• fox, many members of the **dog family (Canidae).**
 
• Look like small to medium-sized bushy-tailed dogs with long fur, pointed ears, and a narrow snout.
 
• Despite the fact that **red foxes are part of the Canidae family **along with dogs, they have more in common with cats. 
 
• Here are some similarities: Like** cats, red foxes are most active at night.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lion, cat and tiger belong to a common family**.
 
• The lion is a member of the** Felidae family, which is a big cat family.**​ 
 
• The leopard is be a member five extant species in the** genus Panthera**, a member of the cat family, **Felidae**.
